claim: Metformin reduces fasting blood glucose in adults with type 2 diabetes.
title: Metformin and glycemic control
abstract: This study examined metformin in adults with type 2 diabetes.
Fasting blood glucose fell significantly in the treatment group.
No significant change was observed in the placebo group.
Adverse events were mild and mostly gastrointestinal.

claim: Regular exercise lowers the risk of cardiovascular disease.
title: Physical activity survey cohort
abstract: A large cohort was surveyed about physical activity habits.
Dietary intake and sleep duration were also recorded.
Follow-up data on employment status was collected.

claim: Vitamin D supplementation improves bone density in postmenopausal women.
title: Vitamin D and bone health trial
abstract: Postmenopausal women received vitamin D supplements for one year.
Bone mineral density increased in the supplemented group.
Calcium intake was matched between the two study arms.
Fracture incidence was not formally assessed.

claim: Vitamin D supplementation cures osteoarthritis in postmenopausal women.
title: Vitamin D and bone health trial
abstract: Postmenopausal women received vitamin D supplements for one year.

claim: Statins increase the risk of hemorrhagic stroke.
title: Statin safety meta-analysis
abstract: A meta-analysis pooled twelve randomized statin trials.
Ischemic stroke risk was reduced across the pooled trials.
Hemorrhagic stroke risk did not increase in the pooled analysis.
Muscle-related adverse events were more common with higher doses.

claim: Aspirin reduces the recurrence of ischemic stroke.
title: Aspirin secondary prevention trial
abstract: Patients with a prior ischemic stroke were randomized to aspirin or placebo.
Stroke recurrence was lower in the aspirin arm over two years of follow-up.
Minor bleeding events were somewhat more frequent with aspirin.

claim: Probiotic supplements reduce the duration of the common cold.
title: Gut microbiome composition survey
abstract: Stool samples were collected from healthy volunteers over six months.
Microbiome diversity was compared across age groups.
No respiratory illness data was collected in this survey.

claim: Beta blockers increase resting heart rate in patients with hypertension.
title: Beta blocker hemodynamic study
abstract: Hypertensive patients were given a beta blocker for eight weeks.
Resting heart rate decreased significantly during treatment.
Blood pressure also decreased over the study period.
No serious adverse events were reported.

claim: Cognitive behavioral therapy reduces symptoms of insomnia.
title: CBT for insomnia randomized trial
abstract: Adults with chronic insomnia were randomized to CBT or a waitlist control.
Sleep onset latency improved significantly in the CBT group.
Total sleep time also improved relative to the waitlist group.
Effects were sustained at a six month follow-up visit.

claim: Air pollution exposure has no association with childhood asthma.
title: Air quality and pediatric respiratory outcomes
abstract: Children in high-pollution neighborhoods were followed for asthma diagnoses.
Asthma incidence was significantly higher in high-pollution areas.
Socioeconomic status was adjusted for in the regression model.

claim: Intermittent fasting improves long-term memory in healthy adults.
title: Circadian rhythm and shift work survey
abstract: Shift workers reported their sleep schedules over a one month period.
Meal timing was recorded but not manipulated experimentally.
No cognitive testing was performed as part of this survey.
